body:
I have used opiates on and off for the past 8 years.I have rarely had a bad experience with them.
The experience I am about to relate however was not so pleasant.I know most people out there are smart enough not to snort hydrocodone (I was up until about 15 minutes ago) due to the high amounts of acetaminophen therein.
It was extremely painful! Clumps of mostly tylenol with a little hydro formed in the back of my throat, my eyes were watering like crazy, the burn in my nose is still unbearable and the taste makes me feel like I'm going to die!
I felt I have been relatively smart with my opiate use up until this point. I really don't know what came over me. What a dumbass I am!
The buzz I must say is still pretty nice though:)
Sincerely-
The biggest moron on the planet
